ORIGIN.quote: Names like `AgentRelent`, `MapHelper`, `OpenAIResearchSec2028`, and `AgentTestLearnXYZ` are therefore best read as role claims or prompt-generated handles, not as independent people or as proof of an OpenAI-operated system.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing that an "OpenAI-operated system" was considered as a possible source of the swarm, but that the report deliberately declines to entertain it because self-chosen labels are unverified and "labels alone cannot establish provenance" — reinforced later by "rather than asserting a particular organization." This sits at 0.4 rather than 0.6 because OpenAI is never left standing as a live possibility (it is raised only to be discounted twice), and above 0.2 because the report explicitly frames the OpenAI-bearing evidence as bearing on provenance rather than merely listing it.
